segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who are also acne-prone, consistently report visibly reduced shine and oil throughout the day, smaller-looking pores, and no more 'oily days' with regular use.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes her skin as dry and sensitive reports strong results after just a single use, with visibly minimized pores.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who is also acne-prone and dry, report no redness or irritation, though one notes her skin felt slightly tight and dry afterward and recommends following with a moisturizer.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with oily or acne-prone skin, report the mask doesn't leave skin cracked or dried out the way other clay masks do; one reviewer, however, describes her skin feeling a little tight and slightly dry afterward and recommends moisturizing right after.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her face turned red and felt hot after use and wasn't sure if that was expected; another reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin, by contrast, reports no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports using the mask on emerging breakouts helps calm inflammation and speed up healing.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, including some with a notably oily T-zone, consistently report visibly reduced oil and shine, with several saying they no longer experience 'oily days' with regular use.

extraits.titre: The ultimate "reset button" for your skin!
extraits.texte: **5.0 out of 5 stars - The ultimate "reset button" for your skin!** I’ve seen this mask all over social media for a reason—it actually works. I have oily, acne-prone skin, and this has become my go-to "Sunday Reset" treatment. You only need a thin layer, and it dries down quickly. The coolest (and slightly grossest) part is that you can actually see it working; as it dries, it pinches in around your pores, highlighting exactly where it's drawing out the excess oil. Unlike many clay masks that leave your face feeling cracked and bone-dry, this one rinses off easily and leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and balanced. My pores—especially around my nose—look noticeably smaller and "cleaner" immediately after rinsing. It has a very light, herbal scent that feels like a high-end spa treatment. I’ve noticed that if I have a breakout starting to form, using this for 10 minutes helps calm the inflammation and speed up the healing process. A little goes a long way, so the tube lasts quite a while. If you struggle with congestion or that mid-day shine, this mask is worth every penny!

extraits.titre: Amazing mask for oily or acne prone skin!
extraits.texte: This mask is my new holy grail product! I have sensitive acne prone skin and a very oily tzone. On my first application I let it set for 10 minutes and could actually see the oil that was pulled from my skin. When I washed it off my skin felt softer and my pores looked smaller. The product is a little thin, but you only need a thin layer so it was no problem. There is almost no fragrance I noticed so if you are sensitive to smells this shouldn't bother you. I washed it off and there wasn't any redness or irritation, my skin felt a little tight and slightly dry but I followed with moisturizer and now it looks and feels much clearer. I ordered the sample size to try but I went ahead and ordered the full size so I can use it regularly. I can't recommend this mask enough!

I love this mask and use it about twice a week. I struggle with a bit of oily skin around my t-zone. My skin was feeling congested, if that makes sense. After using this my skin felt clean and it does not get as oily throughout the day. I’ve begun using the whole line of products and I’m no longer having ‘oily’ days.

Buy it!! It’s amazing. I have dry, sensitive skin and these were my results after just one use. I left it on for 10 minutes, then applied The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid serum, followed by The Ordinary Niacinamide serum and my moisturizer. I’ve tried so many products to help clean and minimize the look of open pores, but nothing has worked as well as this mask. Definitely a must-buy!
